node.title: Condiciones de activación de capacidad
node.summary: Responsibility, access, trust, pressure, resources and interaction make capability usable.

relations: The talent-formation model suggests how coherence-carrying capacity could be cultivated and observed through work rather than inferred from credentials or headcount.
κ requiere definición e instrumento propios; la trayectoria formativa no proporciona automáticamente un score validado.
Carrier availability at an activation threshold and the HID recovery coefficient answer different questions: who can respond now, and what capability returns after the architecture changes.
El protocolo HID no valida por transferencia el radar de κ ni demuestra que una crisis recupere facultades.
Tacit-knowledge transmission offers a practical route for making activation capacity less dependent on a few irreplaceable carriers at the critical moment.
La transmisión no garantiza una densidad κ ni una respuesta superior bajo cualquier carga o régimen.
A deadline is not a readiness condition: a bounded action still needs valid evidence, authority and resources within its declared decision window.
Aplicación hipotética a un relato histórico. No constituye evaluación jurídica de permisos ni auditoría del proyecto.
The frontier-activation essay suggests a further study of how conditions at one interface enable another, with each capability and observation level defined separately.
Extensión propuesta; no hay una Θ agregada válida por el mero hecho de llamar frontera a ambos niveles.
The synthetic reduction distinguishes recognizing an opportunity from activating it, and shows why an equally informed conventional controller must remain a serious comparator.
PR57 está abierto y sus casos son sintéticos; las frecuencias de su grid no son prevalencias de campo ni prueban superioridad de EA.
A useful activation study could test information and joint coordination separately and together, rather than attributing every improvement to additional awareness alone.
El resultado DG4 es de un modelo estipulado en PR58; la complementariedad en campo sigue por comprobarse.
The synthetic agentic reduction offers a bounded comparison of knowing an opportunity and activating it through an authorized joint transition.
El ejemplo no es una validación de Part IV ni una medida de activación de una red real.
An activation can improve output while worsening coordination burden; without a justified conversion rule, that is a trade-off rather than an unqualified improvement.
La comparación es posterior a los relatos de campo; no modifica las definiciones de Part IV ni aporta datos nuevos de la red.
The coordination-entropy account can motivate a factorial test of information and joint-transition mechanisms, including cases where clarity alone does not activate capability.
Es una pregunta de investigación posterior, no una explicación causal ya demostrada de los programas históricos.
